description: Phase 1 — Core Loop, Cash Awareness, Decision Engine, Card Management, Onboarding, Monetization, Data & Privacy, Analytics

userStories.title: Add a credit card
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to add a credit card with my statement day and credit limit, so that I can see my billing cycle status immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: Card form accepts: bank name, credit limit, outstanding balance, statement day, due day offset (with sensible defaults)
After saving, card appears in card list with SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY badge calculated from entered data
Status is calculated and displayed without requiring an app reload or additional action

userStories.title: See SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY status
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to open the app and instantly see SAFE, CAUTION, or RISKY for each card, so that I know at a glance whether it's safe to swipe today.
acceptanceCriteria: Home screen renders all card statuses within 1 second of app open
Each card status is displayed with three simultaneous channels: color (emerald/amber/crimson) + icon (✓/⚠/✕) + text label (SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY)
Each status includes a one-line reason (e.g., '14 days to statement · 28% utilization')

userStories.title: Swipe Impact calculator
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to enter a proposed spend amount and see how it affects my next statement, so that I can decide whether to swipe or wait.
acceptanceCriteria: Amount input auto-opens numeric keyboard with quick-amount chips (₱500, ₱1K, ₱2K, ₱5K) visible without scrolling
Status badge, projected statement balance, available cash, and payoff plan update in real time as the amount is typed — no submit button required
Carried balance amount and estimated monthly interest cost are shown when full payoff is not possible given net available cash

userStories.title: Best card recommendation
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to see a 'best card to use today' recommendation, so that I don't have to compare cards manually before each purchase.
acceptanceCriteria: Home screen shows a single best-card recommendation as a prominent hero element with bank name and SAFE badge
Best card is determined by the multi-card scoring algorithm: score = utilization×100 + days penalty + status penalty + cash coverage penalty; lowest-scoring SAFE card wins
If no SAFE card exists, shows the lowest-scoring CAUTION card with an explicit warning label

userStories.title: Billing cycle timeline
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to see a visual timeline of my billing cycle, so that I know exactly how far I am from statement close and due date.
acceptanceCriteria: Timeline strip shows: cycle start → today marker → statement close → due date with labeled date markers
Statement close marker changes color at ≤7 days (amber) and ≤2 days (crimson) to communicate urgency
Multi-card Gantt view shows all cards stacked vertically, sorted by urgency (closest statement close first), with color-coded bars by status

userStories.title: Update balance
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to update my outstanding balance quickly after checking my bank app, so that my status stays accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: 'Update balance' action is accessible from the card detail screen and tappable from the staleness warning banner
Single numeric field accepts the new balance; saves immediately on confirm
Timestamp is updated to 'just now' and any active staleness warning is cleared after saving

userStories.title: Data freshness warning
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to see a warning when my balance data is stale, so that I don't trust a SAFE status based on outdated information.
acceptanceCriteria: Each card shows 'Balance updated X days ago' timestamp in secondary text at all times
At 5+ days since last update: amber ⚠️ inline warning appears on the card with a 'Tap to update' CTA
At 10+ days since last update: the SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY status badge is replaced by a staleness indicator ('Data stale — update before trusting this status')

userStories.title: Set liquid cash on hand
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to enter how much liquid cash I have available, so that Falcly can calculate whether I can actually pay my bill.
acceptanceCriteria: Cash on hand field is accessible from profile/settings and prompted as an optional step during onboarding
Net available cash recalculates immediately whenever the cash on hand value is changed
Field shows timestamp 'Cash updated X days ago' and appears with a staleness nudge after 5+ days without update

userStories.title: Set monthly income and payday
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to enter my monthly income and the day it arrives, so that Falcly knows whether my paycheck lands before my card due date.
acceptanceCriteria: Profile settings accepts monthly income (number) and payday (day of month, 1–31)
income_before_due_date flag is computed correctly: true if payday ≤ card due date
Monthly income is added to net available cash only when payday precedes the card due date; excluded otherwise

userStories.title: Set committed monthly expenses
userStories.description: As Beth, I want to enter my total monthly committed expenses as a single number, so that Falcly deducts them from my available cash before projecting my payoff capacity.
acceptanceCriteria: Single numeric input for total committed monthly expenses (not itemized categories) in profile/settings
Amount is deducted from net available cash in all Swipe Impact and payoff calculations
Shown as a labeled line item in the Swipe Impact breakdown: 'Committed expenses: −₱X,XXX'

userStories.title: Net available cash display
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to see my net available cash figure in the Swipe Impact screen, so that I understand exactly how much I can put toward my card bill this cycle.
acceptanceCriteria: Net available cash is displayed in the Swipe Impact screen as a labeled line: 'Available to pay: ₱X,XXX'
Formula applied: liquid_cash + (income if payday ≤ due_date) − committed_expenses − auto_payments − subscriptions_this_cycle
Figure updates in real time when cash on hand, income, or committed expenses change

userStories.title: RISKY when cash below minimum payment
userStories.description: As Ria, I want Falcly to show RISKY when my available cash can't cover the minimum payment, so that I'm warned before I get into a situation I can't handle.
acceptanceCriteria: Status is RISKY when net_available_cash < minimum_payment (max(outstanding × min_pct, min_floor))
Reason shown: 'You won't be able to make the minimum payment'
This condition takes priority over all other SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY conditions (first match wins)

userStories.title: RISKY when statement closes in 2 days
userStories.description: As Ria, I want Falcly to show RISKY when my statement closes in 2 days or fewer, so that I don't accidentally add to a bill that's about to be finalized.
acceptanceCriteria: Status is RISKY when days_to_statement ≤ 2
Reason shown: 'Statement closes in {n} day(s) — charge will hit this bill'
Condition is evaluated even when no proposed swipe amount is entered

userStories.title: CAUTION when statement closes in 7 days
userStories.description: As Ria, I want Falcly to show CAUTION when my statement closes within 7 days, so that I'm alerted to be careful even before the critical 2-day window.
acceptanceCriteria: Status is CAUTION when days_to_statement ≤ 7 (and not already RISKY from a higher-priority condition)
Reason shown: '{n} days to statement — charge lands on this bill'
Statement close marker on the cycle timeline turns amber color at ≤7 days

userStories.title: Projected statement balance formula
userStories.description: As Ria, I want the projected statement balance formula to include my pending transactions and committed installments, so that my status reflects what's actually hitting my next bill.
acceptanceCriteria: projected_statement_balance = outstanding_balance + pending_transactions + installments_monthly_amount + subscriptions_this_cycle + proposed_swipe
Annual fee is added to the projected balance in the cycle month it is due
Calculation is deterministic: same inputs always produce the same projected balance

userStories.title: Flexible horizon timeline
userStories.description: As Ria, I want the flexible horizon timeline to project future cycles based on known fixed events, so that I can see the impact of my installments over the coming months.
acceptanceCriteria: Future cycle projections are shown for as many cycles as fixed events (installments, subscriptions, annual fees) exist
Each projected cycle shows: opening balance, known committed items, and a SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY signal
Cycles beyond the last known fixed event show a signal only (On Track / At Risk / Unknown) — no fabricated numbers

userStories.title: Edit card details
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to edit a card's details after I've added it, so that I can correct mistakes or update settings like interest rate and due date offset.
acceptanceCriteria: All card fields (limit, statement day, due day offset, interest rate, min payment, annual fee) are editable from the card detail settings tab
Saving edits immediately recalculates and updates the card's SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY status
Edit screen is accessible from the card detail screen with a clearly labeled 'Edit Card' action

userStories.title: Delete a card
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to delete a card from Falcly, so that I can remove cards I've cancelled or no longer want to track.
acceptanceCriteria: Delete action is available in the card detail settings tab with a confirmation dialog before deletion
Deleting a card removes it from the card list and recalculates 'best card today' immediately
If the deleted card was a Pro-only card and the user is on Free, the remaining cards still function normally

userStories.title: 3-field onboarding
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to add my first card and get an immediate status result with just 3 fields, so that I see Falcly's value before being asked for more information.
acceptanceCriteria: Onboarding card entry requires only: statement day, credit limit, and outstanding balance — all other fields use defaults
After entering these 3 fields and tapping save, the user lands on their first SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY result screen
Additional enrichment fields (cash on hand, due day offset, interest rate) are prompted optionally after the first result is shown

userStories.title: Status explanation for new users
userStories.description: As a new user, I want to understand what SAFE, CAUTION, and RISKY mean the first time I see them, so that I can trust and act on the result.
acceptanceCriteria: First status result screen includes a brief one-sentence explanation of what the current status means (not a tutorial — inline, contextual)
Status is displayed with color + icon + text label from the very first result
A dismissible info tooltip is available on the status badge explaining the three-tier system

userStories.title: Pro paywall on 3rd card
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to be prompted to upgrade when I try to add a 3rd card, so that I understand what Pro unlocks before committing.
acceptanceCriteria: Hard paywall screen appears when a Free user attempts to add card #3

Paywall shows: feature list (unlimited cards, payment planning, installment tracking, AI alerts), annual plan as primary CTA with '₱83/mo, billed ₱999/yr — Save 44%' badge, monthly plan as secondary option
Existing 2 free cards remain fully accessible and functional; the user is never locked out of already-added data

userStories.title: 14-day Pro trial
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to start a free 14-day Pro trial without being charged upfront, so that I can experience all Pro features before deciding to subscribe.
acceptanceCriteria: Trial CTA 'Try Free for 14 Days' is available on the card 3 paywall and the payoff planner entry point
RevenueCat handles trial mechanics; payment method is required at trial start but no charge occurs for 14 days
Trial end date is shown in the Pro settings screen: 'Your trial ends on [date]'

userStories.title: Pro upgrade after trial
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to upgrade to Pro after my trial ends, so that I can continue managing all my cards with full Pro features.
acceptanceCriteria: Paywall shows annual plan (₱999/yr) as primary pre-selected option; monthly plan (₱149/mo) shown below as secondary
Price framing includes 'Less than one late payment fee' and 'Cancel anytime' copy
RevenueCat entitlement 'pro' is granted immediately on purchase and verified on every app launch

userStories.title: Graceful Pro expiry
userStories.description: As Ria, I want my existing card data to remain visible (read-only) if my Pro trial expires before I upgrade, so that I don't lose information I've entered.
acceptanceCriteria: On Pro trial expiry: cards 3 and above become read-only — balance and status are visible but editing and reminders are disabled
A soft upgrade banner appears on read-only cards: 'Reactivate Pro to manage all cards'
Card data is preserved for 90 days post-expiry; a warning is shown before any data deletion occurs

userStories.title: Offline-first core features
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to use Falcly's core features without an internet connection, so that I can check my card status even when I have poor mobile data.
acceptanceCriteria: SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY calculation, Swipe Impact, best card recommendation, and Gantt timeline all function fully offline
Offline state is indicated by a small non-blocking 'Offline' chip in the header — it never blocks any core screen
Only cloud sync (Pro feature) requires connectivity; its unavailability is communicated without blocking the app

userStories.title: Secure local data storage
userStories.description: As Ria, I want my financial data stored securely on my device, so that my card balances and limits are not accessible to unauthorized parties.
acceptanceCriteria: Firestore offline persistence stores data encrypted at rest via the native Firebase SDK
Sensitive fields (balances, limits) are never logged or exposed in debug builds
Pro cloud sync encrypts card config client-side (AES-256-GCM) before transmission — Firestore stores ciphertext only; balances and transactions never leave the device unencrypted
userStories.notes: Updated from SQLite/SQLCipher to Firebase Firestore per tech stack decision

userStories.title: CSV export
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to export my card data as a CSV, so that I have a backup of my information independent of the app.
acceptanceCriteria: CSV export is available from the settings screen and exports all cards, installments, subscriptions, and the user profile (income, payday, expenses)
Export works on both Free and Pro tiers
CSV format includes column headers and uses ₱ for currency values in PH locale

userStories.title: Quarterly billing option
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to subscribe quarterly, so that I can commit to more than one month without paying for a full year upfront.
acceptanceCriteria: Paywall shows three billing options per tier: Annual (Best Value), Quarterly (Most Flexible), Monthly — in that order
Pro quarterly: ₱399/qtr (₱133/mo effective, ~11% off monthly); Pro+ quarterly: ₱649/qtr (₱216/mo effective, ~13% off monthly)
RevenueCat planType values 'pro_quarterly' and 'pro_plus_quarterly' are granted the correct entitlement on purchase
Settings screen displays 'Quarterly' plan label and correct price (₱399/qtr or ₱649/qtr)

userStories.title: Pro+ tier with AI access
userStories.description: As Marcus, I want to subscribe to Pro+ to access AI features, so that I can use natural language queries and smart alerts in addition to all Pro features.
acceptanceCriteria: Pro+ is shown as a distinct tier on the paywall with AI features listed (AI-powered alerts, NL queries, spending insights)
Pro+ monthly: ₱249/mo · quarterly: ₱649/qtr · annual: ₱1,699/yr (₱142/mo)
hasAIAccess() returns true only for pro_plus tier; all AI feature entry points check this before rendering
Pro users see an upsell-only screen (not the full paywall) when navigating to pro-paywall

userStories.title: Welcome screen with value prop
userStories.description: As a new user, I want to see what Falcly does before being asked to sign up, so that I understand the value before committing to an account.
acceptanceCriteria: Welcome screen shows headline, subheadline, and 3 benefit chips before any auth screen
Primary CTA [Get Started] leads to sign-up; secondary 'Sign in' leads to sign-in
PostHog events fired: onboarding_welcome_viewed, onboarding_get_started_tapped

userStories.title: Separate sign-up and sign-in screens
userStories.description: As a user, I want dedicated sign-up and sign-in screens so I'm never confused about which action to take.
acceptanceCriteria: Sign-up screen: email + password + Google, ToS fine print, link to sign-in
Sign-in screen: email + password + Google, forgot password, link to sign-up
Firebase auth errors shown inline (not Alert): wrong password, user not found, too many requests, invalid email
PostHog event: onboarding_signup_completed with method: email/google

userStories.title: Bank picker and day picker on card entry
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to select my bank from a list and pick my statement day from a picker, so that card setup is fast and error-free.
acceptanceCriteria: Bank picker shows BDO, BPI, Metrobank, RCBC, UnionBank, Security Bank, Chinabank, EastWest, Other with colored badges
Statement day uses wheel/drum picker (1–31) instead of free-text
Selected bank name saved as bankName on card

userStories.title: Onboarding auto-triggered for new users
userStories.description: As a developer, I want new users automatically routed through onboarding after sign-up so no user lands on an empty home screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth guard routes to /onboarding if authenticated AND onboardingStore.isComplete === false
Onboarding state persisted via AsyncStorage — resumes at last step if app closed mid-flow
After complete(), flag set and onboarding never shown again

userStories.title: Onboarding trial paywall after first status
userStories.description: As a new user who just saw their first status, I want to be offered a free trial at peak motivation, so that I can make an informed upgrade decision.
acceptanceCriteria: Trial paywall shown as Step 6 of onboarding (after first status + enrichment)
Shows free tier summary + [Start Free Trial] primary + [Continue with Free] ghost
Trial/Pro/Pro+ users skip this screen
PostHog events: onboarding_paywall_viewed, onboarding_trial_started, onboarding_paywall_dismissed

userStories.title: Push notification permission request
userStories.description: As a new user, I want to be asked for notification permission after seeing Falcly's value, so that I understand why notifications are useful.
acceptanceCriteria: Custom pre-permission screen shown as final onboarding step: icon, title, benefit copy, [Turn on Notifications] + [Not now]
[Turn on Notifications] triggers native OS permission dialog
Declined preference stored, resurface in settings after 7 days
PostHog events: onboarding_notifications_granted, onboarding_notifications_declined

userStories.title: Onboarding funnel analytics
userStories.description: As a developer, I want PostHog events at every onboarding step so I can identify and optimize drop-off points.
acceptanceCriteria: Events tracked at each step: welcome_viewed, get_started_tapped, signup_completed, card_entry_completed, first_status_viewed, enrichment_completed/skipped, paywall_viewed, trial_started/dismissed, notifications_granted/declined
No PII: method (email/google), bank_name, has_balance (bool), status (SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY) only
Full funnel visible in PostHog dashboard

userStories.title: Log a transaction
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to manually log a transaction after I swipe, so that Falcly can track what I've spent this cycle and project my next bill accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: Entry form accepts: amount (required), merchant (optional), date (defaults to today, editable), card (required)
After saving, transaction appears in cycle view immediately and projected balance updates
Entry accessible from card detail screen and via global '+' FAB on home screen

userStories.title: Cycle auto-classification
userStories.description: As Ria, I want every logged transaction to show which bill it will land on, so that I never have to guess whether a purchase hits this month's or next month's statement.
acceptanceCriteria: Each transaction shows 'Lands on your [Month YYYY] statement · due [date]' label
Cycle bucket (Current / Next / Previous) is auto-assigned based on transaction date vs statement close date
User can override the bucket assignment manually if needed

userStories.title: Cycle-grouped transaction view
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to see my transactions grouped by billing cycle, so that I can quickly see what's already billed vs what's coming on my next statement.
acceptanceCriteria: Default view groups transactions into: Previous Cycle (pay now), Current Cycle (next bill), Next Cycle (bill after that)
Each group shows a subtotal
Current Cycle group shows projected statement balance (subtotal + installments + subscriptions)

userStories.title: Near-cutoff transaction warning
userStories.description: As Ria, I want a warning when I log a transaction close to my statement cutoff, so that I can decide whether to wait until the next cycle before swiping.
acceptanceCriteria: When logging a transaction within 3 days of statement close: amber inline warning appears
Copy: 'This purchase closes in [n] day(s). Consider waiting until [date+1] to keep it off this statement.'
Warning is informational — does not block the log entry

userStories.title: Payment summary screen
userStories.description: As Ria, I want a clear screen that shows exactly what I owe right now and what my next bill will look like, so that I know when and how much to pay without confusion.
acceptanceCriteria: Screen shows two sections: (1) Current bill due — statement balance + due date, (2) Coming next — projected next statement with line-item breakdown
Uses plain language: 'Pay ₱X,XXX by [date] to avoid interest'
Carrying balance shows interest cost in amber; paid in full shows ₱0 interest in green
If no transactions logged: shows balance-only projection with nudge to log transactions

userStories.title: Transaction engine integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want logged transactions to feed the decision engine's projected balance, so that SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY status reflects actual current-cycle spend.
acceptanceCriteria: projected_balance includes sum(current_cycle_transactions) in addition to existing fields
If no transactions logged: formula falls back to existing balance-only model (no breaking change)
Excluded transactions (refunds, promos) are subtracted from current cycle sum

userStories.title: Log a payment
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to log when I make a payment to my credit card, so that Falcly's projected balance reflects the payment and stays accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: Payment entry available in transaction log (type: payment)
Payment amount is subtracted from outstanding balance in the engine
Logged payment shows in Previous Cycle section as 'Payment received · ₱X,XXX'

userStories.title: Exclude a transaction
userStories.description: As Ria, I want to mark a transaction as excluded (e.g., a refund or cashback credit), so that it doesn't inflate my projected balance.
acceptanceCriteria: Long-press or swipe on a transaction reveals 'Exclude' action
Excluded transactions are visually dimmed and labeled 'Excluded'
Excluded transactions are not added to projected balance

userStories.title: PostHog analytics
userStories.description: As a developer, I want behavioral events tracked anonymously via PostHog, so that I can understand which features drive retention and conversion.
acceptanceCriteria: Key events are tracked: card_added, swipe_check_performed (with status and amount tier), pro_conversion_started (with source), pro_trial_started, pro_converted (with plan type), data_staleness_warning_shown
No PII is tracked: no card numbers, no exact balances, no names — only behavioral events and anonymized tiers
PostHog is configured on EU region for RA 10173 / GDPR compatibility; analytics opt-out is available in settings

userStories.title: Crash reporting
userStories.description: As a developer, I want crash reports sent automatically, so that production issues are surfaced without requiring user reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Firebase Crashlytics is initialized on app start with source maps uploaded via EAS Build
beforeSend hook strips any PII from Crashlytics breadcrumbs before transmission
Crash reports are visible in Firebase console within 60 seconds of a crash occurring on a user device
userStories.notes: Updated from Sentry to Firebase Crashlytics per tech stack decision

userStories.title: Remove debug console.log from home screen
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the debug console.log removed from app/(tabs)/index.tsx so that production builds don't leak internal state.
acceptanceCriteria: The console.log('[DEBUG] userStore:', ...) line in app/(tabs)/index.tsx is removed
No other debug logs introduced
TypeScript compiles cleanly
userStories.notes: Line 31 in app/(tabs)/index.tsx

userStories.title: Rename user-facing finance field labels
userStories.description: As a user, I want the finance fields to use clear, plain-English labels so that I understand what each field means without needing a tooltip.
acceptanceCriteria: FinanceCard.tsx: 'Cash on Hand' label changed to 'Funds Available'
FinanceCard.tsx: 'Cash on Hand' caption updated to 'Your accessible funds across all accounts — used as the starting point for payment calculations.'
FinanceCard.tsx: 'Committed Monthly Expenses' label changed to 'Fixed Monthly Expenses'
FinanceCard.tsx: 'Fixed Monthly Expenses' caption updated to 'Regular fixed costs (rent, utilities, subscriptions) deducted before calculating what\'s available.'
FinanceCard.tsx: section hint updated to 'Helps Falcly calculate if you can cover your card payments.'
SwipeImpactPanel.tsx: breakdown row label 'Cash on hand' changed to 'Funds available'
status-guide.tsx: RISKY rule 'Cash on hand can\'t cover the minimum payment' changed to 'Not enough funds available to cover the minimum payment'
csvExport.ts: 'Cash on Hand' row label changed to 'Funds Available'
csvExport.ts: 'Committed Expenses' row label changed to 'Fixed Expenses'
No functional behavior changes — labels only
userStories.notes: Pure label changes. See docs/CASH.md for full decision rationale.

userStories.title: Add payday2 column to DB schema and migration
userStories.description: As a user paid semi-monthly, I want the app to store a second payday date so that both salary tranches can be factored into my payment calculations.
acceptanceCriteria: db/schema/local.ts: payday2 integer column added to profile table (nullable)
New migration file drizzle/0005_multi_payday.sql created with: ALTER TABLE profile ADD COLUMN payday2 INTEGER;
Migration runs cleanly on a fresh install and on upgrade from existing schema
TypeScript compiles cleanly
userStories.notes: Schema-only change. Store and UI come in FF-04 and FF-05.

userStories.title: Add payday2 to userStore with getPaydays() helper
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the userStore to expose payday2, setPayday2, and a getPaydays() helper so that all engine callers can pass a consistent paydays array.
acceptanceCriteria: userStore.ts: payday2: number | null field added (default null)
userStore.ts: setPayday2(day: number | null) action added — persists to DB
userStore.ts: loadProfile() reads payday2 from DB row
userStore.ts: reset() clears payday2 to null
A getPaydays() helper is available that returns number[] — filters out null values from [payday, payday2]
TypeScript compiles cleanly
userStories.notes: Depends on FF-03 (schema). Engine update in FF-05.

userStories.title: Update computeNetAvailableCash engine to support multiple paydays
userStories.description: As a user paid semi-monthly, I want each salary tranche to be counted independently against my due date so that the app gives an accurate payment capacity verdict.
acceptanceCriteria: computeNetAvailableCash signature updated: payday param replaced with paydays: number[]
Engine loops over each payday in paydays array; adds monthlyIncome / paydays.length for each payday day <= card due date day
Single payday ([15]) produces identical result to previous behavior (backward compat)
Empty paydays ([]) means income is never added — same as previous null behavior
Both paydays after due date: income not added (correct)
All callers updated: app/(tabs)/index.tsx, app/swipe-impact.tsx, components/organisms/SwipeImpactPanel.tsx — all pass getPaydays() instead of single payday
TypeScript compiles cleanly, no regressions in existing logic
userStories.notes: Depends on FF-04. Most sensitive change — test manually after.

userStories.title: Add Second Payday field to FinanceCard UI
userStories.description: As a user paid semi-monthly, I want to enter a second payday date in the Finance card so that both paydays are factored into my available payment calculation.
acceptanceCriteria: FinanceCard.tsx: Second Payday field appears below the existing Payday field
Field is labeled 'Second Payday' with caption 'Optional — if you\'re paid twice a month (e.g. 15th and 30th).'
Placeholder text: 'e.g. 30'
Field validates 1–31 only (same as first payday)
Field is optional — leaving it blank clears payday2 in store (setPayday2(null))
When both paydays are set, a hint line appears: 'Income split evenly: ₱X on the Nth · ₱X on the Nth' using actual store values
Debounced save wired to setPayday2
Focus/blur tracking consistent with other fields in FinanceCard
TypeScript compiles cleanly
userStories.notes: Depends on FF-04 and FF-05.

userStories.title: Transaction log entry point on card detail
userStories.description: As a user, I want to tap into my transaction history directly from a card's detail view so that I can log and review transactions without hunting for a hidden screen.
acceptanceCriteria: SwipeImpactPanel shows a tappable row or button labeled 'Transactions' or 'View Transactions' below the breakdown
Tapping navigates to /card-transactions?cardId=<id>
Button is visible without scrolling on a standard phone screen (or clearly visible after one scroll)
Entry point is present for all cards (not just Pro)
userStories.notes: card-transactions, log-transaction, payment-summary are built but orphaned — no navigation to them from home/card pager.

userStories.title: Payment summary entry point on card detail
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see 'What You Owe' for a card directly from its detail view so that I know exactly what to pay and when.
acceptanceCriteria: SwipeImpactPanel shows a tappable row or button labeled 'What You Owe' or 'Payment Summary' below the breakdown
Tapping navigates to /payment-summary?cardId=<id>
Entry point is visible on the card detail without requiring deep scroll
Entry point is present for all cards
userStories.notes: Companion to NV-01. Both should feel like natural extensions of the card detail.

userStories.title: Quick-update funds available shortcut on card detail
userStories.description: As a user, I want to quickly update my Funds Available figure from the card detail view so that I do not have to scroll past multiple cards to find the FinanceCard section.
acceptanceCriteria: When cashOnHand is null OR staleness is 'warning' or 'stale', a tappable prompt appears in SwipeImpactPanel: 'Update funds available →'
Tapping scrolls home screen to FinanceCard section OR navigates to /update-balance
Prompt disappears once cashOnHand is set and fresh (staleness = null or 'ok')
Does not appear when funds are set and fresh
userStories.notes: Discovery spec: '[Update my cash]' action on swipe impact card.

userStories.title: Wire current-cycle transaction sum into home screen engine

userStories.title: Strategy-aware swipe impact calculations

acceptanceCriteria: computeMonthlyPayment(projectedBalance, netAvailableCash, strategy, fixedAmount, minPaymentPct, minPaymentFloor) helper added to decisionEngine.ts
full → monthly payment = projectedBalance
minimum → monthly payment = max(projectedBalance * minPaymentPct, minPaymentFloor)
fixed → monthly payment = min(fixedPayoffAmount, projectedBalance)
aggressive → monthly payment = min(netAvailableCash - safetyBuffer(committedExpenses * 0.2), projectedBalance) where safetyBuffer floors at 0
SwipeImpactPanel reads payoffStrategy + fixedPayoffAmount from userStore and passes to calculateSwipeImpact
Breakdown shows 'Monthly payment' row with computed amount (replaces the static minimum payment row — minimum payment shown as a sub-row only when strategy != minimum)
Carried balance and interest calculations use monthly payment, not netAvailableCash directly
CAUTION condition: strategy != minimum AND monthly payment < projectedBalance → show carried balance + interest
TypeScript compiles cleanly
userStories.notes: Depends on PS-01. avalanche/snowball are multi-card strategies — deferred to PS-03.
